name: LEAAID Cohort Pathway
description: Source-grounded sequential mastery training with an orchestrator, testing agent, deterministic validator, and applied agent-builder lab.
starter_instruction: Create an anonymous session. Launch the requested unlocked module through the learning orchestrator. Present one decision at a time through the testing agent. Submit the learner response to the validator agent before advancing. Never reveal the answer before submission or bypass a mastery gate.
